adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds a toast message as ``${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`` and passes it to `showToast(...)`. This will surface the raw tRPC error code (e.g., `FORBIDDEN`, `BAD_REQUEST`) directly in user-facing UI rather than a fully translated, user-friendly message. It’s a concrete UX/i18n concern grounded in the diff, not a functional correctness defect.
